summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist. Files: monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (new loader with private _resolve_path helper), monai/data/__init__.py (explicit import export), docs/source/data.rst (Decathalon DataLoader subsection under Utilities with autofunction entry), tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py (TestLoadDecathalonDatalist with four tests). Nothing committed. Tests, black, and flake8 were not run, per instructions; line lengths were measured (max 117 columns, under the 120 limit). Choices: non-mapping top-level JSON is reported as a missing-key ValueError; non-list value under the data key raises ValueError; malformed JSON surfaces as json.JSONDecodeError (a ValueError subclass) and is not caught; base_dir defaults to the datalist file's directory portion.
